**Apply progress: issue-473 — PR #504 cold-review round 2 fixes applied**

Change: issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff. Artifact store: hybrid. Adds to the prior revision (obs #2727, round 1): PR #504 (branch feat/issue-473-s3-approve-cli) received a cold-review ROUND 2 with 2 confirmed findings. Both fixed, gates green, no push.

## Cold-review round 2 fixes (this session)

### Finding 1 (MAJOR) — provider-conditional transport config, commit a376383
`brain/scripts/approve/cli.mjs`: round-1's fix (76139b5) threaded `gitlabApiConfig()` UNCONDITIONALLY into all 6 vcs call sites (whoami, mrList, prView x2, prReviewComment, prReviews). Correct on GitLab. WRONG on GitHub (this repo's ACTIVE provider — brain.config.json `vcs.provider: "github"`): `providers/github.mjs`'s `whoami({token})` overrides identity to the GH_TOKEN env override's account (github.mjs:35-39) while `prView`/`mrList`/`prReviews`/`prReviewComment` ignore `token`/`apiBase`/`proxyUrl` entirely and use the ambient `gh` session — with VCS_TOKEN divergent from the `gh` login, whoami claims one identity and the post lands under another (deny-check evaluates the wrong identity; post-then-verify catches it but only AFTER a comment already landed).

Fix: `const vcsConfig = vcs.PROVIDER === 'gitlab' ? gitlabApiConfig() : {};` — GitHub gets an empty config at every site (ambient `gh` everywhere, including whoami — never a token). Provider detection idiom: `vcs.PROVIDER` (the module-namespace export from providers/github.mjs / providers/gitlab.mjs, both export `export const PROVIDER = 'github'|'gitlab'`) is read directly off the already-resolved `vcs` object from `getVcsFn`. This EXACTLY mirrors `review/identity.mjs`'s `defaultWhoami`:
```
if (vcs.PROVIDER === 'gitlab') {
  const { apiBase, proxyUrl } = gitlabApiConfig();
  return vcs.whoami({ token, apiBase, proxyUrl });
}
return vcs.whoami({ token });
```
No new production param needed — the provider seam already exists via `vcs.PROVIDER`.

**Latent repo-wide issue check (report only, not fixed here)**: audited `vcs/actor-check.mjs` (lines 680/708/747/785, threads `gitlabApiConfig()` into `labelEvents`/`issueView`/`prCommits`/`prReviews`) — NONE of these call `whoami`, and github.mjs's implementations of those four verbs don't destructure `token`/`apiBase`/`proxyUrl` at all, so the threading there really is a harmless no-op on GitHub as its own comment claims. `review/identity.mjs` already guards its own `whoami({token})` call by `vcs.PROVIDER === 'gitlab'` (pre-existing, not part of this fix). Searched `review/cold-boot.mjs`, `review/board.mjs`, `vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs`, `governance/run-check.mjs` for `whoami` calls threaded with `gitlabApiConfig()` — none found. Conclusion: `approve/cli.mjs` was the ONLY unconditional-whoami-token-threading site in the repo; no other latent exposure found.

RED-first: extended `locks.test.mjs`'s `makeVcs(overrides, provider='gitlab')` to accept/expose `.PROVIDER`. Replaced/extended `REQ-473-CONFIG` with a provider matrix: (a) `REQ-473-CONFIG (gitlab)` x2 — existing assertions, unchanged behavior; (b) `REQ-473-CONFIG (github)` x2 — new: asserts `'token' in capturedWhoami === false` and that no captured call (whoami/mrList/prView x2/prReviewComment/prReviews) receives `apiBase`/`token`/`proxyUrl` (all `undefined`, and `apiBase` explicitly `!==` the real gitlab apiBase value). Verified RED against pre-fix code (2 failing: `actual: 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4'` on whoami — proving the bug concretely, not just structurally), then GREEN after the fix (81/81 in approve/*.test.mjs, up from 78).

### Finding 2 (MINOR) — stale doctrine header, same commit a376383
`cli.mjs:30-31` (now ~30-37): rewrote Lock 2's header claim from unqualified "no environment read exists" to the honest scoped claim — this FILE reads the environment zero times itself (still structurally pinned, Lock 2 test unchanged); transport config resolved via `ci-context.mjs` MAY read env for GitLab transport (VCS_TOKEN/CI_API_V4_URL/proxy), which cannot affect the prompt/confirmation-word/abort paths (cites the BYPASS_ENV behavioral pin in locks.test.mjs); on GitHub no transport config is read at all, after Finding 1's fix. Avoided the literal substring `process.env` in the comment (same gotcha as round 1 — it would trip the Lock 2 structural test's raw-source scan).

## Commits (chained on 12610d2, branch feat/issue-473-s3-approve-cli, NOT pushed)
- a376383 — fix(approve): thread transport config only when the provider is gitlab (#473)

## Gates (all green)
- `node --test brain/scripts/approve/locks.test.mjs brain/scripts/approve/cli.test.mjs`: 81/81 pass (was 78, +3).
- `npm test`: 2875/2875 pass, 0 fail (was 2872, +3).
- `npm run repo:check`: PASS.
- `npm run brain:nav`: PASS.
- `.memory/**` left unstaged/uncommitted throughout, no push performed.

## Status
Slice 3 (PR3/PR4) cold-review round 2 findings fully resolved. No new deviations. H.1/H.2 (human-only ADR promotion + re-signing) remain outstanding as before (unchanged from round 1).
